### 21. OpenAI o1 vs GPT-4o: Benchmark and Enterprise Cost Guide

- Canonical URL: https://bunusradar.site/blog/openai-o1-vs-gpt-4o-benchmark-and-enterprise-cost-guide
- Published Date: 2026-10-25T06:00:00Z
- Category: Technology
- Primary Author: Alex Vance (Lead AI & Systems Researcher)
- Key Tags: OpenAI, Artificial Intelligence, Enterprise AI, LLM Benchmarks, Cloud Computing
- Executive Summary: A comprehensive benchmark and economic comparison of OpenAI o1 and GPT-4o across reasoning, coding, and enterprise infrastructure cost structures.
- Core Takeaways:
  * Inference-Time Compute Paradigm: OpenAI o1 trades instantaneous responses for internal reasoning tokens, radically elevating problem-solving at the expense of latency.
  * Steep Unit Economics: With an input cost of $15.00/1M tokens and output cost of $60.00/1M tokens (plus hidden reasoning tokens), o1 costs significantly more per interaction than GPT-4o ($2.50 input / $10.00 output).
